이 포스트는 `Jiming Jiang, Thuan Nguyen - Linear and Generalized Linear Mixed Models and Their Applications`의 연습 문제를 리뷰한다.

## 3.1

**Show that, under the assumption made in the first paragraph of Sect. 3.2, the vector of observations,** $y=\left(y_1, \ldots, y_n\right)^{\prime}$, has the same distribution as the Gaussian linear mixed model (1.1), where $\alpha \sim N(0, G), \epsilon \sim N\left(0, \tau^2 I\right)$, and $\alpha$ and $\epsilon$ are independent.

$$
\begin{aligned}
y& =X \beta+Z \alpha+\epsilon \\
f_i\left(y_i \mid \alpha\right) &=\exp \left\{\frac{y_i \xi_i-b\left(\xi_i\right)}{a_i(\phi)}+c_i\left(y_i, \phi\right)\right\}
\end{aligned}
$$

문제에 있는 정보를 정리하면,

$$
y \mid \alpha \sim N\left(X \beta+Z \alpha, \tau^2 I\right)
$$

Conditional Distribution이 Normal을 따르므로 평균과 분산은 다음과 같다.

$$
\begin{aligned}
E[\mathbf{y}] & =X \beta+Z E[\boldsymbol{\alpha}]+E[\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}]=X \beta, \\
\operatorname{Var}(\mathbf{y}) & =Z \operatorname{Var}(\boldsymbol{\alpha}) Z^{\prime}+\operatorname{Var}(\boldsymbol{\varepsilon})=Z G Z^{\prime}+\tau^2 I .
\end{aligned}
$$
